verdicts.reason: A is faithful but is mostly a shrunk copy: the subtitle still sits right on top of the CTA, the text is small for the canvas, and about 100px of empty space is left at the bottom while the badge floats lower than in the original. B fills the space better but breaks things: the NEW FLAVOR badge is blown up so it competes with the headline, the logo moves off the centre axis into an awkward shared top row, the subtitle wraps and leaves 'hour.' alone on its own line, and the CTA is jammed close to the bottom edge.
